api.error.network.defaultMessage: サーバーに接続できませんでした。接続を確かめて、もう一度試してください。
api.error.network.description: Error message when a request to the server got no answer (offline, or the server is down).

api.error.status.defaultMessage: サーバーが要求を処理できませんでした（エラー {status}）。しばらくしてから試してください。
api.error.status.description: Error message when the server failed without describing the problem. {status} is the HTTP status code, for example 502.

compose.close.description: Accessible name of the × button that closes the new-post sheet. The draft is kept.

compose.failed.defaultMessage: 投稿できませんでした: {reason}
compose.failed.description: Error after publishing a post failed. The draft is kept. {reason} is the error message.

compose.language.label.description: Label of the choice of the language a post is written in.

compose.language.und.description: Choice of post language when the user does not say which language the post is in.

compose.media.add.description: Button that opens the file picker to attach images to a post.

compose.media.description.hint.defaultMessage: 画像を見られない人のために、画像の内容を書いてください。
compose.media.description.hint.description: Help text under the alternative text field of an attached image.

compose.media.description.label.description: Label of the alternative text field of an attached image. {position} is its number in the post, from 1.

compose.media.description.required.defaultMessage: 画像を見られない人のために、画像の内容を書いてください。設定で、すべての画像に説明を付けるようにしています。
compose.media.description.required.description: Help text under the alternative text field of an attached image when the user's settings ask for a description of every image.

compose.media.failed.defaultMessage: 添付できませんでした: {reason}
compose.media.failed.description: State of an attached image whose upload failed. {reason} is the error message.

compose.media.failed_processing.defaultMessage: サーバーがこの画像を処理できませんでした。
compose.media.failed_processing.description: Why an attached image failed: the server could not process it.

compose.media.hint.defaultMessage: {max, plural, other {# 枚}}まで（JPEG・PNG・GIF・WebP）。位置情報などのメタデータは、送る前に取り除きます。
compose.media.hint.description: Help text next to the button that attaches images. {max} is the most images a post can have.

compose.media.list.description: Accessible name of the list of images attached to the post being written.

compose.media.processing.description: State of an attached image while the server prepares it.

compose.media.remove.description: Button that removes an attached image from the post. {position} is its number in the post, from 1.

compose.media.too_many.defaultMessage: 画像は {max, plural, other {# 枚}}までです。残りは追加しませんでした。
compose.media.too_many.description: Notice when the user picked more images than a post can have. {max} is the most images a post can have.

compose.media.unsupported.defaultMessage: {name} は JPEG・PNG・GIF・WebP の画像ではありません。
compose.media.unsupported.description: Notice when a picked file is not an image type the server accepts. {name} is the file name.

compose.media.uploading.description: State of an attached image while it is being sent to the server.

compose.missing_description.add.description: Button of the confirmation that goes back to the form to describe the images.

compose.missing_description.body.defaultMessage: 説明のない画像が {count, plural, other {# 枚}}あります。画像を見られない人には、何が写っているか伝わりません。
compose.missing_description.body.description: Text of the confirmation about images without a description. {count} is how many images have none.

compose.missing_description.post.description: Button of the confirmation that posts without the descriptions.

compose.missing_description.title.defaultMessage: 画像の説明なしで投稿しますか？
compose.missing_description.title.description: Title of the confirmation shown when attached images have no description and the user's settings ask for one.

compose.open.description: Floating button on phones and tablets that opens the form for a new post.

compose.outbox.discard.description: Button that throws away a post that could not be sent.

compose.outbox.edit.description: Button that puts a post that could not be sent back into the form.

compose.outbox.failed.defaultMessage: 送信できませんでした: {reason}
compose.outbox.failed.description: State of a post that could not be sent. {reason} is the error message.

compose.outbox.label.description: Accessible name of the list of posts that are being sent or could not be sent.

compose.outbox.retry.description: Button that sends a post that could not be sent again.

compose.outbox.sending.description: State of a post that is being sent.

compose.outbox.unsent.defaultMessage: まだ送信していません。
compose.outbox.unsent.description: State of a post whose sending was interrupted (for example by reloading the page).

compose.over.defaultMessage: {count, plural, other {# 文字}}多すぎます
compose.over.description: Counter under a text field when the text is longer than allowed. {count} is how many characters are over.

compose.posted.description: Notice after a post was published.

compose.remaining.defaultMessage: 残り {count, plural, other {# 文字}}
compose.remaining.description: Counter under a text field: how many more characters fit. {count} is a number.

compose.reply.cancel.description: Button that turns the reply being written into a normal post.

compose.reply.label.description: Above the new-post form: the post being replied to. {name} is the author's display name or handle.

compose.reply.unavailable.defaultMessage: 返信先の投稿を表示できません。
compose.reply.unavailable.description: Shown instead of the post being replied to when it could not be loaded.

compose.sensitive.defaultMessage: 画像を、読む人が表示するまで隠す
compose.sensitive.description: Checkbox that marks the attached images as sensitive.

compose.submit.description: Button that publishes the new post.

compose.submit.reply.description: Button that publishes the reply being written.

compose.text.label.description: Label of the text area where the user writes the text of a post.

compose.title.description: Heading of the form that writes a new post (the side panel on wide screens, the sheet on phones).

compose.visibility.button.description: Button that opens the choice of who can see the post. {visibility} is the current choice, for example 'Public'.

compose.visibility.direct.description: Visibility of a post: only the mentioned people.

compose.visibility.direct.description.defaultMessage: メンションした人だけ。

compose.visibility.done.description: Button that closes the list of visibility choices.

compose.visibility.limited.defaultMessage: 公開範囲「{visibility}」で投稿しました。あなたのアカウントは、いまはこれより広く投稿できません。
compose.visibility.limited.description: Notice after posting when the server narrowed the chosen visibility because of a restriction on the account. {visibility} is the visibility the post got, for example 'Followers'.

compose.visibility.local.description: Visibility of a post: signed-in people of this server and the author's followers. Not the same as 'local only' in other software: followers on other servers receive it.

compose.visibility.local.description.defaultMessage: このサーバーにログインしている人と、ほかのサーバーのあなたのフォロワー。このサーバーのローカルタイムラインに載ります。

compose.visibility.private.description: Visibility of a post: the author's followers and the mentioned people.

compose.visibility.private.description.defaultMessage: あなたのフォロワーと、メンションした人だけ。

compose.visibility.public.description: Visibility of a post: everyone, and listed on the public timelines.

compose.visibility.public.description.defaultMessage: このサーバーとほかのサーバーのだれでも。公開タイムラインに載ります。

compose.visibility.title.defaultMessage: この投稿を見られる人
compose.visibility.title.description: Label of the list of visibility choices for a post.

compose.visibility.unlisted.description: Visibility of a post: everyone, but kept off the public timelines.

compose.visibility.unlisted.description.defaultMessage: リンクを知っているだれでも。公開タイムラインには載りません。

compose.warning.description.defaultMessage: 読む人はまずこの文を見て、投稿を表示するかを選びます。
compose.warning.description.description: Help text under the content warning field.

compose.warning.label.description: Label of the field with the content warning text of a post.

compose.warning.toggle.description: Checkbox that adds a content warning: a short text shown instead of the post until the reader opens it.

home.title.description: Heading and document title of the home timeline page.

local.title.defaultMessage: ローカルタイムライン
local.title.description: Heading and document title of the page with the public posts of this server's accounts.

login.body.defaultMessage: {instance} にログインすると、投稿したり、ほかの人をフォローしたり、ホームタイムラインを読んだりできます。
login.body.description: Text on the sign-in page. {instance} is the name of this server.

login.failed.denied.defaultMessage: サーバーの画面でログインが取り消されました。
login.failed.denied.description: Why signing in failed: the user declined on the server's authorization screen.

login.failed.invalid_state.defaultMessage: このログインはこのタブで始めたものではないか、すでに完了しています。もう一度始めてください。
login.failed.invalid_state.description: Why signing in failed: the answer from the server does not belong to a sign-in that this browser tab started.

login.failed.rejected.defaultMessage: サーバーがログインを受け付けませんでした。もう一度始めてください。
login.failed.rejected.description: Why signing in failed: the server refused to finish it (for example, it took too long).

login.failed.retry.defaultMessage: もう一度ログインする
login.failed.retry.description: Link from the failed sign-in page back to the sign-in page.

login.failed.title.defaultMessage: ログインできませんでした
login.failed.title.description: Heading and document title of the page shown when signing in failed on the way back from the server's sign-in screen.

login.submit.description: Button on the sign-in page that opens the server's sign-in screen.

login.title.description: Heading and document title of the page that starts signing in.

notifications.title.description: Heading and document title of the notifications page.

page.not_built.defaultMessage: この画面はまだ準備中です。
page.not_built.description: Text below the heading of a page whose screen the web client does not have yet.

profile.title.description: Heading and document title of the signed-in user's own profile page.

session.account.title.description: Heading of the section of the settings page about the signed-in account.

session.sign_in.description: Link in the account section of the settings page that opens the sign-in page.

session.sign_out.description: Button that signs the user out of the app in every tab.

session.sign_out.failed.defaultMessage: この画面からはログアウトしましたが、サーバーに接続できませんでした。ページを再読み込みするとログインした状態に戻ることがあります。
session.sign_out.failed.description: Notice after signing out when the server could not be told; the browser may still hold the session.

session.signed_out.defaultMessage: ログインしていません。
session.signed_out.description: Text in the account section of the settings page when nobody is signed in.

settings.title.description: Heading and document title of the settings page.

shell.about.domain.defaultMessage: このサーバーのアカウントは @{domain} で終わります。
shell.about.domain.description: In the side column about this server: the domain of the handles of local accounts, for example 'Accounts here end with @example.com.'.

shell.about.title.defaultMessage: このサーバーについて
shell.about.title.description: Heading of the side column, shown on wide screens, that tells about the server the user is on.

shell.document_title.description: The browser tab title: the heading of the current page, then the server's name.

shell.error.body.defaultMessage: このページを表示できませんでした。もう一度試すか、しばらくしてから開いてください。
shell.error.body.description: Text on the page shown when a screen failed to load or broke.

shell.error.retry.description: Button that loads the failed page again.

shell.error.title.description: Heading of the page shown when a screen failed to load or broke.

shell.loading.description: Accessible name of the progress indicator shown while a page loads.

shell.nav.home.description: Navigation item that opens the home timeline. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.nav.label.description: Accessible name of the main navigation (the tab bar on phones, the side rail on larger screens).

shell.nav.local.description: Navigation item that opens the local timeline (posts of this server's accounts). Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.nav.notifications.description: Navigation item that opens the notifications. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.nav.profile.description: Navigation item that opens the user's own profile. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.nav.settings.description: Navigation item that opens the settings. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.not_found.body.defaultMessage: このアドレスのページはありません。
shell.not_found.body.description: Text on the page shown for an address that the web client has no page for.

shell.not_found.home.defaultMessage: ホームタイムラインへ
shell.not_found.home.description: Link on the not-found page back to the home timeline.

shell.not_found.title.defaultMessage: ページが見つかりません
shell.not_found.title.description: Heading of the page shown for an address that the web client has no page for.

shell.skip_to_main.description: Link at the very start of every page, visible when focused, that moves keyboard focus past the navigation.

shell.startup_error.body.defaultMessage: サーバーから届いた設定をアプリが読み取れませんでした。ページを再読み込みしてください。繰り返し起きる場合は、サーバーの管理者に知らせてください。
shell.startup_error.body.description: Text shown instead of the app when its runtime configuration from the server is missing or invalid.

shell.startup_error.title.defaultMessage: アプリを起動できませんでした
shell.startup_error.title.description: Heading shown instead of the app when its runtime configuration from the server is missing or invalid.

shell.toast.dismiss.description: Accessible name of the × button that closes a toast message.

shell.toast.region.description: Accessible name of the area where short status messages (toasts) appear, such as 'Post published'.
